title: 遍历 channel 求和
description: 发送后 close 再 range 求和
full_code:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	ch := make(chan int, 3)
	ch <- 1
	ch <- 2
	ch <- 3
	close(ch)
	s := 0
	for v := range ch {
		s += v
	}
	fmt.Println(s)
}

points.hint: 关闭 channel 结束 range

explanation: 发送完 `close(ch)` 后 `range` 才结束；不关闭则无限等待。
